entities.name: John Cadwalader
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Cadwalader was an 18th-century American lawyer, jurist, and politician who served one term as a United States representative from Pennsylvania and 11 years a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania.
